description: This PHP class, HoursField, defines behavior for handling hours in a cron schedule, including validation, satisfaction checks, and incrementing hours while considering timezone changes.

classes.name: HoursField
classes.description: A class extending AbstractField, providing methods to evaluate, validate, and modify hour values in cron scheduling logic.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the given date's hour satisfies the cron hours condition.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments or decrements the hour in the DateTime object, adjusting timezone temporarily to UTC to handle DST changes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the given cron hour expression is well-formed.
